---
title: Analyzing School Districts and Americans' Time Use
author: Jordin Shurpin
format: html
execute: 
  echo: false
---

{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)


{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), "data/seda_2025.duckdb")
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
dbplyr_state <- tbl(con, "state_scores")


{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
score_change <- dbplyr_dist |>
filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
select(sedaid, year, rla_score) |>
pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = rla_score, names_prefix = "rla_") |>
filter(!is.na(rla_2015), !is.na(rla_2023)) |>
mutate(score_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
collect()

state_change <- dbplyr_state |>
filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
select(stateabb, year, rla_score) |>
pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = rla_score, names_prefix = "rla_") |>
filter(!is.na(rla_2015), !is.na(rla_2023)) |>
mutate(score_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
collect()


{r}
dist_2023 <- dbplyr_dist |>
filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
collect()

n_districts <- nrow(dist_2023)

dist_2023 |>
ggplot(aes(x = rla_score)) +
geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.2, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
labs(
title = "Distribution of District Reading Scores in 2023",
subtitle = paste0("Includes data across ", scales::comma(n_districts), " school districts"),
caption = "Data source: SEDA 2025 Database",
x = "RLA Score",
y = "Count"
) +
theme_minimal()


{r}
n_districts_change <- nrow(score_change)

score_change |>
ggplot(aes(x = score_change, fill = score_change > 0)) +
geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1, color = "white") +
geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
scale_fill_manual(
values = c("TRUE" = "steelblue", "FALSE" = "firebrick"),
labels = c("TRUE" = "Improved", "FALSE" = "Declined"),
name = "Change Status"
) +
labs(
title = "Distribution of District Reading Score Changes (2015 to 2023)",
subtitle = paste0("Based on ", scales::comma(n_districts_change), " districts with data in both years"),
caption = "Data source: SEDA 2025 Database",
x = "Change in RLA Score (2023 - 2015)",
y = "Count"
) +
theme_minimal()


{r}
state_change_plot <- state_change |>
mutate(stateabb = reorder(stateabb, rla_2023))

state_change_plot |>
ggplot(aes(y = stateabb)) +
geom_point(aes(x = rla_2015), color = "gray60", size = 2) +
geom_segment(
aes(x = rla_2015, xend = rla_2023, yend = stateabb, color = score_change > 0),
arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"), type = "closed")
) +
scale_color_manual(
values = c("TRUE" = "steelblue", "FALSE" = "firebrick"),
labels = c("TRUE" = "Improved", "FALSE" = "Declined"),
name = "Change Direction"
) +
labs(
title = "State Reading Score Changes (2015 to 2023)",
subtitle = "Gray dots mark 2015 baseline scores; arrows indicate direction and magnitude of change by 2023",
caption = "Data source: SEDA 2025 Database",
x = "Reading Score (RLA)",
y = NULL
) +
theme_minimal()
